text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Concord Properties Developments Corp has undertaken the construction of an 89-storey condominium at 363-391 Yonge Street. The site is located on the southeast corner of Yonge Street and Gerrard Street East. At its meeting on December 17 and 18, 2024, City Council authorized the temporary closure of a portion of O'Keefe Lane, from December 18, 2024 to January 31, 2026. At the time, the developer indicated they would require the staging area for a total of 38 months, from December 18, 2024 to January 31, 2028, however, the occupation was only approved for a 14 month period. The developer has requested a time extension of the duration of the construction staging area on O'Keefe Lane as a result of delays caused by weather and building plan revisions which increased…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the continuation of the closure of a 6.6 metre wide portion of O'Keefe Lane, between a point 38 metres south of Gerrard Street East and a point 33.5 metres further south, from May 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, inclusive. 2. Directed the applicant to continue to pressure wash or sweep (weather permitting) the construction site and adjacent sidewalks and roadways daily, or more frequently as needed to be cleared of any construction debris and made safe. 3.
